name: Rouen citizens assembly on climate change
content: Problems and Purpose The municipality is setting up a citizens' convention.Participants will work on adapting the city to risks posed by climate, health and industry. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Rouen Municipal Government Participant Recruitment and Selection Rouen citizen assembly will bring together around thirty inhabitants drawn by lot and representing the diversity of the territory. Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation A work of anticipation and projection fed by the hearing of experts who will take stock of the existing solutions in the event of major risks and on the avenues of reflection in progress. Influence, Outcomes, and Effects At the end of these three sessions, the citizens' convention will provide elected officials with a report containing proposals and recommendations.
